mapper.select: SELECT intent_type as intentType, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(intent_confidence) as averageConfidence FROM conversation_log WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND intent_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY intent_type ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(elem.tool_element AS bigint) as tool_id, t.display_name as tool_name, COUNT(*) as usage_count, AVG(cl.execution_time_ms) as avg_duration FROM conversation_log cl CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(cl.invoked_tool_ids) AS elem(tool_element) LEFT JOIN tools t ON CAST(elem.tool_element AS bigint) = t.id WHERE cl.agent_id = #{agentId} AND cl.invoked_tool_ids IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(cl.invoked_tool_ids) > 0 GROUP BY elem.tool_element, t.display_name ORDER BY usage_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(elem.tool_element AS bigint) as toolId, t.display_name as toolName, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(cl.execution_time_ms) as averageDurationMs FROM conversation_log cl CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(cl.invoked_tool_ids) AS elem(tool_element) LEFT JOIN tools t ON CAST(elem.tool_element AS bigint) = t.id WHERE cl.agent_id = #{agentId} AND cl.invoked_tool_ids IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(cl.invoked_tool_ids) > 0 GROUP BY elem.tool_element, t.display_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, agent_id, session_id, user_query, final_response, intent_type, intent_confidence, decision_path, invoked_tool_ids, searched_kb_ids, decision_model_id, response_model_id, total_input_tokens, total_output_tokens, total_cost, execution_time_ms, status, error_message, user_rating, user_feedback, created_at FROM conversation_log WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND user_rating IS NOT NULL AND user_rating <= 2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
